keep.text: The biggest misconception about weight loss is that it's about willpower.
It's about biology. Here's what I mean.
When your insulin is chronically high,
your body can't access fat. It's physically locked away.
No amount of willpower unlocks it.
When your cortisol is high from stress and bad sleep, your body stores fat around your belly,
on purpose, as a survival response.
You are not weak. Your system is broken.
And that's why my protocol attacks all four systems simultaneously.
Fasting, diet, exercise, meditation. All four.
I used this to go from 110 kgs to 85 kgs in just 45 days. I reduced 10% body fat in the last 30 days only.
I'll teach you the entire system in a live webinar. Stop fighting with biology. Start working with it.
